description: Introduce a font-size token scale (tokens-only) and adopt it in components; replace the pre-existing hardcoded Georgia, serif fallback on .imageSlotLabel with var(--font-heading). Folds backlog issue 019eeb89.
title: Harmonize font sizes into a type-scale token system
acceptance_criteria: A documented font-size token set exists in the theme config
Changed components reference tokens (no raw px/font literals introduced)
The Georgia, serif fallback on .imageSlotLabel is gone (uses var(--font-heading))
